text: Someone asks a favour, and your mouth says yes before you do.
So shuffle. Cut. The deck knows nothing. It only makes you ask three things, in order.
First, the Lantern. What, exactly, is being asked? Say it in a single sentence.
Second, the Key. What does it cost? Count the hours, not the feelings.
Third, the Tide. Will it still matter in a year?
It lands upside down. Reversed means: not yet.
Any murky card, and the answer waits.
